utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Klar, ich fahr nachher vorbei und schau mir das an.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Danke dir, Leo. Das hilft mir echt.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know when the repair drive starts and who’s handling the pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the start time and who’s doing the pickup?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need those details before I can commit, especially the start time and who’s picking things up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I must've missed the update, what changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: We had to move the date back a bit, and the parts list changed too. I can fill you in if you want the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring it up with Ira again and keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik. Let me know if you need me to pass along anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I will, and I’ll let you know if there’s anything specific to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A few folks are still waiting on tools and a hand with the porch step. I can point you to the pile if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, point me to the pile and I’ll take the tools to the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for it, Quinn. Tell me what needs fixing first and I’ll keep to the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Start with the roof leaks and the broken front steps; once those are sorted, we can move down the list together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. I’ll stick to that order and keep track of the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s left to fix on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the smaller stuff now: a loose hinge, a leaky faucet, and that cracked step by the porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. Which one should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. I can ask around and see who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, I’ll keep asking around and help connect anyone who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for bringing it up, Rosa. I can help with the repair drive and make sure I follow through on my part.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d be glad to help set a time and line up the materials. I’ll keep track of my part so we can get it done.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over extra tape and a box of screws if we’re short on supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll check what else we need and keep it stocked.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up again this afternoon, and folks are dropping off tools by the community center. If Rey needs anything, I can point him to the right volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. I’ll stop by and see if I can use a hand with anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll send him over to Mara at the front table, and she can match him with a team.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What exactly needs repairing for the drive? I want to make sure I get the details right before I say I can help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly it’s the hallway lock and the loose handrail by the front steps. If you can help with either of those, that would cover the biggest stuff.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help with either one, but the lock sounds like the first priority since it’s the main entry.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I appreciate it. I’ll let you know what I hear next.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can bring that up with Jules and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep the repair drive moving from my end too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Jules. I’ll bring it up and keep the repair drive moving on my end too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I missed what changed, can you tell me what’s going on?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a bit behind on it, but I think people are gathering for the repair drive soon. What changed since I last heard about it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, actually. If you’ve got a drill and a ladder, I could use both.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can bring both over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Opal. I’m keeping the repair drive list tight and I’ll make sure every volunteer knows where to start.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep track of the houses and mark the ones that still need attention.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll match your house list to the volunteers so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to make sure the timing and pickups are sorted before we start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can handle pickups and timing, and I’ll spread the word so people know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, as long as the pickup window is clear and people know the spot, I’m comfortable with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s happening, but I want to confirm the timing before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but the timing’s still not locked down yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m ready to help if you’ve got the parts and a time in mind. Let’s keep it simple and get the repair drive done in order.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can grab the parts and help finish it if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No problem. Grab the parts and tell me when you’re back, and we’ll finish it in order.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m still catching up. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s a donation and repair day at the community center. Folks are bringing tools, hardware, and a hand, and I’m keeping track of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — what do they still need most?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to bring up my ladder too, but I keep forgetting these things.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Bring it by and I’ll put a reminder on the sign-up sheet so it doesn’t slip your mind again.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara. I’ll bring the ladder by and check the sheet so I don’t forget again.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, that helps. I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll check in after school pickup.
